compatibility.description: efficiency-table column '50A + 50R' pairs RXM50R with FVXM50A. NOTE vertical merged band 'Connexion multi uniquement' spans this column -> this pairing is for MULTI-split connection only; monosplit eligibility unverified. Page blurb: 'Possibilité de combinaison avec des unités extérieures multi à 2 et 3 ports (sauf 2-3MXM68)'. No invented pairing beyond the published column.
